arguments.name: INPUT_FILE
arguments.description: The path or URL to a YAML or JSON file with Rest API  specification.

arguments.name: OUTPUT_FILE
arguments.description: The path for output excel file.

options.name: --depth
options.description: Maximum depth level for documenting object hierarchies  (defaults to 10).

options.name: --lang
options.description: Language of the generated document: a language code or a  path to a json file with a translation.

options.name: --no-sanitize
options.description: Reject the input file instead of correcting its  specification errors.

description: Generate Rest API specification in a MS Excel format
